summary: Iteration 2 testing of Morris — email field on signup/profile + password reset flow. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests pass (13 new email/reset tests + 13 regression tests, including signup_verify_login updated to send email). Frontend: full E2E verified — signup with 4 fields (username/email/password/phone) -> OTP demo -> verify -> select-trade -> /app; Forgot password link on /login; /forgot-password returns demo reset link panel; clicking anchor navigates to /reset-password?token=... with token-input HIDDEN (auto-populated from URL); password mismatch + <6char errors both shown via toast; reset succeeds -> /login; login with NEW password succeeds; /reset-password without ?token shows manual token input; Profile email field shows email, save persists across reload. No critical bugs found in the iteration 2 changes.

minor.issue: Successful signup returns OTP in `body.otp` plain text — by design (DEMO MODE) per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Production must remove this and integrate Twilio.
DEMO MODE returns reset token+link in API response (intentional). Production must replace with email send (Resend) and stop returning token.

issues: Update password button has gold gradient that looks slightly washed-out / muted when token is empty (disabled state). Cosmetic, not a bug.

action_items: (Documentation) Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md context for next agent: VerifyOtp page testid is 'otp-submit' (not 'verify-otp-submit'); SelectTrade page testid is 'trade-submit' (not 'trade-save'). The iteration-1 context note had the wrong names.
(Low) Consider adding inline form-validation hints on /reset-password (e.g., 'minimum 6 characters' helper text under New password) — currently only surfaced via toast on submit.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/auth/forgot-password: existing-email path returns demoResetToken; non-existing path does NOT — this is the desired privacy-vs-demo split per the spec. Documented and verified by test_forgot_password_nonexistent_email_no_token_leak.
server.py /api/auth/reset-password: correctly $unset's user.token on successful reset, invalidating the existing session. Verified by test_reset_password_full_flow_and_session_invalidation.

server.py password_reset_tokens collection: token TTL stored as ISO string in `expiresAt`. MongoDB index created on expiresAt at startup — but it is NOT a TTL index (no expireAfterSeconds). Old used/expired records will accumulate forever. Suggest: create_index('expiresAt', expireAfterSeconds=0) with expiresAt as BSON Date (not ISO string) for automatic cleanup, OR run a periodic purge.
server.py: email uniqueness is enforced both at app-level (await db.users.find_one({email})) and DB-level (unique sparse index on email). Good belt-and-braces.
server.py SignupReq uses pydantic EmailStr — validates format; tested both 422 on missing + 422 on bad format.
Profile.jsx: email field is type='email' but does NOT have client-side required attr — relies on server EmailStr. Acceptable since blanks can be intentional for users who haven't set it.
ResetPassword.jsx: when initialToken present, the hidden state still passes token to disabled-check (button disabled when !token). Correct UX.
ForgotPassword.jsx: demoResetLink rendered as a relative <Link to={...}> which works because react-router parses /reset-password?token=… into pathname+search. Verified working end-to-end.
